clues.text: The Gospel writers explain that the Hebrew name of this place, where Jesus was crucified, means The Place of the Skull.
On the way to this place, soldiers forced Simon of Cyrene to carry the cross of Jesus.
At this place, soldiers offered Jesus wine mixed with gall, but after tasting it He refused to drink.
At this place, the soldiers who crucified Jesus divided up His garments by casting lots.
Jesus was crucified at this place with two others, one on each side and Him in the middle.
At this place, Pilate had a notice posted on the cross reading: JESUS OF NAZARETH, THE KING OF THE JEWS.
After Pilate handed Jesus over, He was crucified at this place, which lay near the city.
